title: When the Will Turns Anew
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Gideon Okafor, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
